summary: Create a KubeVirt VirtualMachine whose containerdisk volume uses ${OCI_DISK_IMAGE_REPO}:${OCI_IMAGE_TAG} and whose cloudinitdisk uses cloudInitConfigDrive with secretRef enrollment-secret, then `oc apply -f my-bootc-vm.yaml`.
questions: How do I create a VirtualMachine from a bootc container disk?
How do I attach cloud-init from a secret to a KubeVirt VM?
What VirtualMachine manifest works for an Edge Manager device?

answer_card.title: VirtualMachine for an Edge Manager device
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
apiVersion: kubevirt.io/v1
kind: VirtualMachine
metadata:
  name: my-bootc-vm
spec:
  runStrategy: RerunOnFailure
  template:
    spec:
      domain:
        cpu: {cores: 1}
        memory: {guest: 1024M}
        devices:
          disks:
            - {name: containerdisk, disk: {bus: virtio}}
            - {name: cloudinitdisk, disk: {bus: virtio}}
      volumes:
        - name: containerdisk
          containerDisk:
            image: ${OCI_DISK_IMAGE_REPO}:${OCI_IMAGE_TAG}
        - name: cloudinitdisk
          cloudInitConfigDrive:
            secretRef: {name: enrollment-secret}
```
`oc apply -f my-bootc-vm.yaml`
